subject.title: Add tree view command to visualize active agents

question: Should OpenClaw add a public active-agent hierarchy view now, and should it live as `openclaw tree`, under `openclaw sessions`, in the TUI, or behind narrower recursive subagent/session-chain work?
rationale: The missing source surface is clear, but adding it creates a new public CLI/TUI/API contract and overlaps with recursive subagent listing, session-chain metadata, and Control UI orchestration work.

options.title: Add Narrow Sessions Tree
options.body: Approve a read-only text and JSON hierarchy built from existing session/subagent lineage, with watch mode and resource metrics left for follow-up.

options.title: Fold Into Chain Work
options.body: Keep this issue open but make it depend on session-chain or recursive subagent-list semantics before adding a separate public command.

options.title: Defer Broad Tree Surface
options.body: Document existing flat sessions/subagents inspection and defer a tree command until maintainers want a broader orchestration surface.

recommendation.title: Add Narrow Sessions Tree
recommendation.body: Approve a read-only text and JSON hierarchy built from existing session/subagent lineage, with watch mode and resource metrics left for follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest routing candidate for the public CLI/Gateway product-surface decision and recent current-main ownership signal.
